source_context.creator: Diandra Escobar
source_context.caption_hook: If you want true inbound from LinkedIn: EVERY SINGLE post needs a JOB. This four-bucket funnel is how I build six-seven figure pipelines from content alone.
caption_argument_segments: If you want true inbound from LinkedIn: EVERY SINGLE post needs a JOB. This four-bucket funnel is how I build six-seven figure pipelines from content alone.
Most people post whatever comes to mind and hope for the best.
That's a slot machine, not a strategy.
After building some of the biggest personal brands on LinkedIn (and building an agency that's pulled in over $1M from content alone), I realized every post falls into one of four buckets.
Each one has a specific job in the funnel:
→ Growth (40% of posts) Gets you discovered by new people. Hot takes, industry commentary, bold observations. This is your top of funnel. Broad enough to attract, sharp enough to stand out.
